question: 'Bauhche' is a traditional bridegroom’s sword worn during a tribal wedding ceremony in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Bauhche' **is a traditional bridegroom’s sword worn during a tribal wedding ceremony in **Arunachal Pradesh.**

 
• In Arunachal Pradesh, Men wear sleeveless silk shirts and Women wear sleeveless chemise with an embroidered.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Andhra Pradesh - Men wear Dhoti and Kurta and Women wear Sari and Blouse.
 
• Madhya Pradesh • Men wear Dhoti and Women wear Lehenga and Choli.
 
• Mizoram • "Puan" is a black and white cloth worn like a skirt, which is the state dress.
